review_text: I absolutely loved Bound By Magic. The characters were easily my favorite part of the story—they felt distinct, emotionally engaging, and surprisingly easy to become attached to. I especially enjoyed the tension and chemistry between them, and the magical elements gave their relationships an extra layer of intrigue. By the end, I was completely invested and genuinely wished I had more pages to read.

Bound By Magic was a captivating read with memorable characters and a wonderfully atmospheric magical setting. The character relationships kept me interested from beginning to end, especially as their motivations and emotions became more complicated. A few moments moved a little faster than I expected, but overall I really enjoyed the story and would definitely recommend it to anyone who likes character-driven fantasy with romance and mystery.
